title: docs(skills): objectstack-ai says a delete_record the human named, with one record matching, is already approved
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99ewj5JRWXTB3u38E9HLhnj)_

Fixes #34456
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-ai` 技能的 MCP 工具表里，删除一行的说法改成和工具本身一致：用户点名要删的记录、且只匹配到一条时，这句话本身就是确认，AI 直接带 `confirm: true` 删，不再二次询问；名字匹配多条或没指明哪条时，先列出候选、问清再删。
- 为什么改：#34453 已把这条规则写进 `delete_record` 的工具说明和服务端技能，但仓库里的技能文件还写着“每次删除都先问人”，读技能的 AI 会对用户已点名的删除再问一遍。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文档里一行，服务端仍拒绝不带 `confirm: true` 的删除，行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` MCP 工具表 `create_record`, `update_record`, `delete_record` 那一行。
- 两分钟验证：对照 `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `DELETE_NAMED_RECORD_IS_APPROVAL` 与 `DELETE_AMBIGUOUS_ASKS_FIRST`，两句意思一致。
- 需要你做的：`skills/**` 是受管面，需要 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 批准后才转 ready。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, MCP tools table, the `create_record`, `update_record`, `delete_record` row. "ask the human first, then retry" becomes the rule the `delete_record` tool description carries since #34453 (`DELETE_NAMED_RECORD_IS_APPROVAL` and `DELETE_AMBIGUOUS_ASKS_FIRST` in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`): a request naming the record to delete, with exactly one record matching, is the human's approval, so the agent sends `confirm: true` on that call without asking again; when the name matches more than one record, or the request does not identify one, the agent lists the candidates, asks which one, and sends `confirm: true` only after the answer. The server-side refusal of a `delete_record` without `confirm: true` is unchanged.

Changeset: `.changeset/34456-skill-delete-record-named-approval.md`, `@objectstack/skills` patch (`skills/**` ships in it).
